nodes.label: Git Branching & Version Control Strategy
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.rationale: Uses a Three-Tier Integration Flow (transient -> develop -> main) with Squash and Merge to support 4-sprint velocity without destabilizing production.

nodes.label: Atomic Commit Rule (Client + Supabase Migrations)
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.rationale: Requires client code, shared schemas, and supabase/ migrations (with explicit GRANTs and RLS) to travel in the same commit/PR so reviewers validate UI/API and security together.

nodes.label: SCRUM-Linked Conventional Commits & Branch Naming
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.rationale: Mandates SCRUM-<number> keys in branches, commits (.husky/commit-msg), and PR titles to keep Git history readable and automate Jira transitions and release notes.

nodes.label: MyCCS Documentation Synchronization & Architecture Re-Baseline Brief
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.norm_label: myccs documentation synchronization & architecture re-baseline brief
nodes.rationale: Reconciles contradicting docs/jira specifications around the confirmed MyCCS product scope anchored on SAB SCRUM-9 for a 5-person team over 4 sprints.

nodes.label: Keyed Blind Index Transform (Encrypted PII vs. CSV Lookup)
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.norm_label: keyed blind index transform (encrypted pii vs. csv lookup)
nodes.rationale: Resolves the contradiction between randomized PII ciphertext and fast SQL email matching by pairing email_ciphertext + key_version with an indexed HMAC-SHA256 email_blind_index.

nodes.label: Standalone web-admin/ Segmentation Transform
nodes.author: Alexis John Rellon
nodes.rationale: Isolates web-admin/ so it is never bundled into the mobile app while sharing Zod schemas and DB types via shared/ to avoid 2-developer maintenance overhead.

nodes.label: Jira-Git Workflow Agent
nodes.rationale: Enforces Jira-linked branches, conventional commits, status transitions, and squash-and-merge hygiene strictly from repository docs without inventing policy.

nodes.label: MyCCS Code Agent
nodes.rationale: Keeps implementation edits small, Expo-compatible, aligned with existing React Native patterns, Jira Git rules, and test updates.

nodes.label: Supabase Architect Agent
nodes.rationale: Enforces migration-first SQL changes, explicit RLS coverage, schema diffs, and atomic co-delivery of frontend and Supabase schema updates.

nodes.label: Jest Coverage Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Minimum per-file coverage thresholds: statements >= 80%, branches >= 75%, functions >= 80%, lines >= 80%; exact percentages must always be reported.

nodes.label: DevSecOps Sentinel Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns dependency security scanning (Snyk, CodeQL SARIF) and authentication correctness in Supabase Deno Edge Functions; critical/high findings are release blockers.

nodes.label: Jira-Git Workflow Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns Jira-aware Git hygiene across the MyCCS monorepo including conventional commits, SCRUM key extraction, branch naming, and idempotent Jira status transitions.

nodes.label: Postman API QA & Documentation Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns API documentation accuracy, integration testing, mock server creation, and Postman collection management via postman-mcp-server.

nodes.label: React Native QA Specialist Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns test quality, Jest coverage gates, Playwright E2E trace evaluation, and mobile AsyncStorage security for the MyCCS Expo React Native app.

nodes.label: Release Manager Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns final delivery stage by aggregating squash-merged PRs, generating stakeholder-readable release notes with Jira links, determining semantic version bumps, and validating Expo EAS download links.

nodes.label: Supabase Architect Agent
nodes.rationale: Owns schema correctness, SQL migration safety, schema diffing, and Row-Level Security (RLS) policy enforcement for the MyCCS Supabase backend.

nodes.label: Git Hygiene Rule
nodes.rationale: Always-on rule enforcing Jira-linked branch naming, Conventional Commits format, protected main/develop branches, Atomic Commit Rule, and Squash and Merge.

nodes.label: Supabase Migration Safety Rule
nodes.rationale: Glob-triggered rule on supabase/migrations/*.sql enforcing RLS policies, backup checkpoints on destructive SQL, auth.uid() usage, timestamp ordering, and paired frontend commits.

nodes.label: PR Readiness CI/CD Gate Rule
nodes.rationale: Model-decision rule verifying 6 CI/CD readiness gates (Jira linkage, target branch, CodeQL/Snyk/CodeRabbit scan awareness, Jest test coverage, migration pairing, Squash and Merge) before opening or reviewing a PR.

nodes.label: Sensitive File Guard Rule
nodes.rationale: Always-on security rule blocking agents from reading, printing, logging, or committing .env files, private keys, certificates, or credential files; permits reading only .env.example or .env.sample for key names.

nodes.label: Edge Function JWT Validation Rule
nodes.rationale: Every Deno Edge Function accessing user data must call supabaseClient.auth.getUser() or equivalent JWKS verification and validate both aud and iss claims to prevent unauthorized access.

nodes.label: Idempotent Jira Status Transition
nodes.rationale: Never transition a Jira issue to a status it already holds; check current status first via atlassian-mcp-server or Jira REST API.

nodes.label: Postman Environment Parameterization
nodes.rationale: Sensitive authentication data such as tokens or API keys must be parameterized using Postman Environments ({{token}}) and never hardcoded in collections.

nodes.label: AsyncStorage Security Pattern
nodes.rationale: Storing sensitive keys (token, password, secret, auth, jwt, session) in AsyncStorage is critical; use expo-secure-store instead and wrap every AsyncStorage call in try/catch.

nodes.label: Atomic Commit Rule (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: When a feature requires a database change, commit the React Native code and the Supabase migration SQL file in the same commit to keep frontend and schema in sync.

nodes.label: Squash and Merge Policy
nodes.rationale: All PRs targeting develop must use Squash and Merge to keep history clean and align with release note aggregation.

nodes.label: Destructive SQL Backup Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Destructive operations (DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, DROP SCHEMA, TRUNCATE) must be directly preceded by a -- BACKUP CHECKPOINT comment.

nodes.label: Mandatory RLS Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Every CREATE TABLE must enable RLS and define at least one CREATE POLICY using auth.uid() for user-owned rows; USING (true) on sensitive tables is flagged.

nodes.label: Dependabot Configuration
nodes.rationale: Automates weekly npm and GitHub Actions dependency update PRs with conventional commit prefixes and PR limits.
